name: EPA AirNow API
tagline: Real-time and forecast air quality data from the U.S. EPA AirNow program
description: Official U.S. Environmental Protection Agency AirNow web services for current conditions, forecasts, observations, and historical air quality (AQI) data by ZIP code, lat/long, or reporting area. Returns pollutant-level data (ozone, PM2.5, PM10, etc.) used in environmental apps, health alerts, and research.

auth.details: API key via API_KEY query parameter after free self-serve registration at docs.airnowapi.org; key required for all web service calls.

pricing.free_tier_limits: Free after registration; subject to AirNow Data Exchange Guidelines. Public docs do not state a non-commercial-only restriction or separate commercial agreement.

rate_limits: Not publicly documented as a fixed 500 requests/hour per API key; verify limits in the AirNow API account portal or contact AirNow.
use_cases: get current AQI by ZIP code
fetch air quality forecast for lat/long
retrieve historical observations for a reporting area
map nearby monitoring stations and pollutant readings
build health alerts from ozone and PM2.5 AQI
